FR-AUTH-001.note: Login, /me, logout and lockout are exercised against the real API and in the browser.

FR-AUTH-002.note: Password change revokes and rotates sessions; single-use reset token, expiry and revoke-all are tested.

FR-AUTH-003.note: HttpOnly/SameSite cookie with sliding maxAge and token digest are checked; the idle-expiry cutoff itself has no dedicated test.

FR-AUTH-004.note: login.succeeded, login failure, logout, password reset/change and login.locked events are asserted in auth_events.

FR-AUTH-005.note: Every route is checked against a role-permission matrix; Super Admin gets all, unknown roles none.

FR-LOC-001.note: Language switch between fa and en is tested in unit and e2e.

FR-LOC-002.note: RTL for fa and LTR for en is asserted on the html dir attribute, and the session survives the switch.

FR-LOC-003.note: Project output language is its own field shown independent of UI language and drives document headings; no test flips UI language and asserts output is unchanged.

FR-LOC-004.note: Numbers, dates and API error codes are localized from locale-neutral values.

FR-TOP-001.note: Create with UUID, code, title, description and language is tested; topic attachments are not implemented or tested.

FR-TOP-002.note: Case-insensitive duplicate code or title returns a sanitized conflict, scoped per workspace.

FR-TOP-003.note: Edit, archive, restore, soft-delete and purge are covered.

FR-TOP-004.note: Flatness is by schema (no parent column) and is only a negative requirement; no test asserts the absence of a hierarchy.

FR-TOP-005.note: All description versions are kept with reasons; attachments are not implemented so their versions are untested.

FR-TOP-006.note: Dependent projects are listed, deletion is blocked until they are gone, and the project link plus audit trace survive deletion.

FR-PRJ-001.note: Project gets a UUID and a unique readable code; duplicate code returns 409.

FR-PRJ-002.note: Code, title, initial problem, topics and settings are saved via the wizard and API.

FR-PRJ-003.note: Multiple topics with priority order are saved, reordered and validated for availability.

FR-PRJ-004.note: Documented status transitions are enforced by the state machine and the API.

FR-PRJ-005.note: Deleted projects stay recoverable for 30 days with purgeAfter shown, then purge with an audit tombstone.

FR-PRJ-006.note: Clone copies settings and topics without history; secrets exclusion is not asserted explicitly.

FR-PRJ-007.note: Stage milestone, pause reason, health, next action and timeline are covered; listing outputs on the page is not specifically asserted.

FR-CFG-001.note: System, workspace, topic and project scopes are tested and agent-in-project via per-project role copies; there is no run-level config scope test.

FR-CFG-002.note: Effective values and their source scope are returned and shown in the settings UI and wizard preview.

FR-CFG-003.note: Append-only versions with actor, reason and audit before/after are tested; a rendered diff is not specifically covered.

FR-CFG-004.note: A project copies the default role definition, edits stay in the project and the default is not changed.

FR-CFG-005.note: A snapshot is pinned at activation and later changes apply only at the next boundary; per-call recording of the consumed config version is not asserted.

FR-CFG-006.note: Restore appends a new sequence and keeps history append-only (update is rejected).

FR-AGT-001.note: Six roles each start with an active definition including principles, duties, tools and model.

FR-AGT-002.note: Principles and duties are versioned, diffed, edited and rolled back independently.

FR-AGT-003.note: An attempt and its model invocation record the exact definition version and prompt hash; later default changes do not alter them.

FR-AGT-004.note: Role output lists are shown without content, and agent retrieval of project materials is limited to its project and stage.

FR-AGT-005.note: The tool allowlist stays inside the role ceiling and tools outside the pinned list are never offered or run.

FR-WF-001.note: The fixed five-stage order is asserted in definitions and in a real run.

FR-WF-002.note: Audit at knowledge ingest, audited-only retrieval before research, and Brain reports/evaluations are tested; there is no single test of Brain invocation at all three workflow points.

FR-WF-003.note: Manual gates by default wait for a human and automatic gates pass through when configured.

FR-WF-004.note: Pause, resume, cancel and a worker restart keep state and outputs; retry follows the provider retry schedule test.

FR-WF-005.note: Pending human tasks and agent questions move the run to waiting_for_human.

FR-WF-006.note: A repeated command with the same idempotency key creates one review and the workflow replays deterministically.

FR-WF-007.note: The ten-attempt ceiling and the requirement for a recorded admin decision with reason to go past the limit are tested.

FR-WF-008.note: Reviewing a stage output with comment, reject with feedback, edit and approve is tested in e2e and API.

FR-WF-009.note: An edit creates a new version and invalidates the earlier approval.

FR-ANL-001.note: Batches never exceed forty questions and repeated questions are dropped.

FR-ANL-002.note: Minimum thirty and maximum three hundred questions are enforced in domain and in a real run.

FR-ANL-003.note: Text, file, unanswered, irrelevant and later answers are validated and saved.

FR-ANL-004.note: Coverage over the eight required dimensions is graded and gaps block finishing; optional extra dimensions are also tested.

FR-ANL-005.note: The problem definition is versioned and needs admin approval; a rejected one returns to the analyst.

FR-ANL-006.note: Assumptions and unresolved questions are part of the definition and shown in their own sections.

FR-ING-001.note: Presigned file upload, text and policy-checked URL entry are tested, with audio handled as a file.

FR-ING-002.note: MIME sniffing and extraction cover PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, JSON, PNG and WAV; MD and JPG are not separately asserted.

FR-ING-003.note: The size limit comes from the ingestion.max_file_mb setting and over-limit uploads get 413; the 100MB default value itself is not asserted.

FR-ING-004.note: Malware scan (clamd and EICAR), MIME sniff, checksum mismatch and structured metadata extraction are tested.

FR-ING-005.note: OCR with page lineage and transcription adapter segments are tested, but OCR and real transcription tests run only when tesseract or an API key exists.

FR-ING-006.note: A new document version keeps lineage and marks dependent knowledge stale.

FR-KNO-001.note: Items carry a source type (admin_provided and autonomous_research exercised); clue_research is not separately exercised.

FR-KNO-002.note: KNO-001 asserts provenance, scope, version and confidentiality on a created item.

FR-KNO-003.note: Brain audit of document and claims, including injection rejection and per-claim verdicts, is exercised.

FR-KNO-004.note: State machine transitions and approve/needs_revision/rejected thresholds are enforced in tests.

FR-KNO-005.note: Review stores the six scores (credibility, relevance, evidence, recency, bias, conflict) and reasons.

FR-KNO-006.note: Unaudited/pending/rejected knowledge is not retrievable; only approved appears, and research retrieval honours it.

FR-KNO-007.note: New version goes to pending with latestReview null and is not retrievable until re-audited.

FR-KNO-008.note: Override requires a reason (API and DB constraint), is marked human and audited as critical.

FR-KNO-009.note: Conflicts are recorded and every retrieval result carries conflictWarnings until resolved.

FR-KNO-010.note: Citations missing publisher, dates or accessed_at are marked incomplete and make research claims uncited/rejected.

FR-RES-001.note: No web research plan (query, language, country, time range, source policy, target count) exists; research stage retrieves approved internal knowledge only (ADR-0017).

FR-RES-002.note: Unrestricted/whitelist/blacklist research source policy is not implemented; only the ingestion URL allowlist exists, which is not the research policy.

FR-RES-003.note: Findings are not deduplicated into source records; autonomous web research that would produce them is not implemented.

FR-RES-004.note: Knowledge keeps source text, claims and citations separate and research output separates claims from verified evidence; a separate summary field is not asserted.

FR-RES-005.note: RSC-004/008/009 show research.max_queries, knowledge_limit and max_sources settings control retrieval depth; project-scope override is via the generic settings resolver.

FR-RES-006.note: No web access/paywall detection exists; research only reports gaps and missing knowledge, not inaccessible or paywalled sources.

FR-SOL-001.note: SOL-001 rejects counts of 1 and 21 and incomplete model output; default 5 comes from settings (solution.count).

FR-SOL-002.note: Generated solutions carry plan, risks and explained scores and incomplete output is refused; every field (assumptions, evidence) is not individually asserted.

FR-SOL-003.note: Criteria can be disabled and weights must sum to 100, rejected with SOLUTION_CRITERIA_INVALID.

FR-SOL-004.note: Score per criterion with an explanation of the form raw x weight = value and a total is asserted.

FR-SOL-005.note: SOL-003 selects multiple solutions and keeps priority order.

FR-SOL-006.note: Each selected solution gets its own document with an independent lifecycle (draft, submit, approve, lock, supersede).

FR-DOC-001.note: STP-004/005 and level-bounds rule tests validate and serve editable level bounds with system defaults.

FR-DOC-002.note: Level resolves from project settings (document.level) and is set per output on document save; agent-level selection is not separately tested.

FR-DOC-003.note: countCharacters counts only Unicode letters and numbers after NFC.

FR-DOC-004.note: Out-of-bounds document becomes non_compliant and approve is refused with 409.

FR-DOC-005.note: Structured model validation covers headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, citations and charts; figure handled in count/render code but not directly asserted.

FR-DOC-006.note: DOC-102 covers versions, diff, restore, lock and supersede with append-only history.

FR-DOC-007.note: DOCX and PPTX exports are exercised everywhere; PDF only runs where RENDER_PDF is set (it is in CI).

FR-DOC-008.note: Artifacts carry sha256, renderer version and source document version, signed and tamper-detected.

FR-EVA-001.note: System rubric and project override are versioned (scope/versionNo asserted); provider failure is a technical error.

FR-EVA-002.note: Evaluation scores each rubric criterion (requirement coverage, evidence, feasibility, etc.) with evidence.

FR-EVA-003.note: Failures produce findings with severity, evidence and target stage.

FR-EVA-004.note: PATCH on a finding changes targetStage while keeping defaultTargetStage; unknown stage rejected.

FR-EVA-005.note: accepted_with_exception approvalKind and badge are distinct from normal approved.

FR-BRN-001.note: Brain evaluation reads each role charter version (principles and duties) the outputs ran with; deterministic charter-v1 rules also apply.

FR-BRN-002.note: Brain reports charter deviations with clause, role and evidence (REP-002, EVL-002).

FR-BRN-003.note: Project-scope and workspace-aggregate Brain reports are generated and listed.

FR-BRN-004.note: State fingerprint before/after proves Brain reports and evaluations change nothing and only audit report_generated.

FR-BRN-005.note: Recommendations have action, rule and non-empty evidence; model findings need charter clause and real sample.

FR-AI-001.note: OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic adapters pass the same shared-contract tests.

FR-AI-002.note: Live model catalog is refreshed into a dated snapshot; absence of hardcoded model names is not itself tested.

FR-AI-003.note: Only a common request shape (temperature, output limit) plus generic setting validation exist; no per-provider parameter schema validation is implemented or tested.

FR-AI-004.note: Secret is encrypted, write-only, absent from responses, rows and audit; credentials redacted from error text.

FR-AI-005.note: Health check returns healthy/invalid status with a sanitised lastError; last-check timestamp not directly asserted.

FR-AI-006.note: Transient failures follow the 5,5,5,10..40s schedule for ten retries, then the project pauses and can resume.

FR-AI-007.note: Invocations store tokens, latency, finish reason and cost estimate against the project ceiling.

FR-AI-008.note: Connections default to fallback false and a failing project tries no other connection before pausing.

FR-AUD-001.note: Audit events carry actor, action, target, before/after, reason, correlation ID and time (export header and action assertions).

FR-AUD-002.note: History cannot be altered (append-only trigger) and JSON/CSV export is audited.

FR-AUD-003.note: Filters by project, action family, severity and time range with paging; a role filter is not covered.

FR-AUD-004.note: Secrets and confidential project/topic content never appear in audit output.

FR-AUD-005.note: Retention purge writes a minimal audit tombstone (project.purge/topic.purge) that survives deletion.

NFR-SEC-001.note: TLS via Caddy automatic HTTPS is verified on a fresh install in Deploy smoke; at-rest protection is envelope-encrypted provider/integration secrets only, while disk/volume encryption is left to the host and not verified.

NFR-SEC-002.note: RLS read/write/update negative tests run on PostgreSQL 18 in CI and API tests assert cross-workspace and unauthorized access is refused.

NFR-SEC-003.note: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with a per-secret data key wrapped by SECRET_MASTER_KEY from the environment (not the database) is tested, including that the secret never appears in rows or responses; KMS-grade key custody is not tested.

NFR-SEC-004.note: Login and password change use @node-rs/argon2 with env-configurable memory/time/parallelism and a tested minimum floor; no test asserts the $argon2id$ prefix or rehash-on-login upgrade.

NFR-SEC-005.note: Tests show infected/unscannable files stay quarantined and are never parsed, and parsers run in a sandbox without network/writes/child processes with timeout and memory caps; no explicit CPU limit.

NFR-SEC-006.note: URL guard tests cover private/metadata IPs, scheme/credentials/port policy, DNS answers pointing inside, redirects to private targets and pinned-address fetching.

NFR-SEC-007.note: Tests assert injected text stays out of the instruction channel (data in <data>, never-follow rule) and injected knowledge is rejected and never retrieved; real-model resistance is not measured.

NFR-SEC-008.note: No ASVS 5.0 L2 control mapping or external audit exists; CI only runs partial gates (Semgrep, Trivy, audit, ZAP DAST, auth probe) and CodeQL is deferred.

NFR-REL-001.note: The 99.5% availability SLI, burn-rate alerts and dashboard are defined and promtool-tested in CI, but Prometheus is only in the dev observability profile and the third-party-outage exclusion is not implemented.

NFR-REL-002.note: Integration tests on real Temporal prove worker restart loses no workflow, answers or writing progress; deploy-time restarts are not separately tested.

NFR-REL-003.note: Idempotency-Key replays and deterministic workflow replay are tested for transitions and answers; file and provider-call side effects are covered less directly.

NFR-REL-004.note: CI runs a WAL-G point-in-time restore drill and a dump/restore drill with measured RTO against a 4h target; production off-host archiving needs owner S3 settings and a real-server restore rehearsal.

NFR-REL-005.note: The Hardening workflow runs the backup/restore and PITR drills nightly into a separate server in CI; restoring the real production backup on another machine is an owner action.

NFR-REL-006.note: promtool unit tests in CI fire DocooQueueStale and DocooWorkflowFailed; there is no Alertmanager/notification route and no dedicated stuck-workflow age alert.

NFR-PERF-001.note: k6 gate asserts p95 < 500ms for dashboard, project and audit reads at 25 VUs over 1,000 projects in CI; the back-office page < 2s target is not measured.

NFR-PERF-002.note: Long work runs as Temporal workflows with stage/progress state shown in the timeline and analysis views (202 for async commands); no test asserts a latency bound on request handlers.

NFR-PERF-003.note: The k6 load test covers 25 concurrent administrators on 1,000 projects but 25 concurrent agent runs are never exercised, and real-provider capacity is owner-dependent.

NFR-PERF-004.note: Workers are separate processes with a configurable ingestion concurrency, but no horizontal-scale test exists and there is no per-provider concurrency setting.

NFR-PERF-005.note: Cursor pagination with filter-bound cursors is tested for projects, audit events, knowledge and sources; the document list is not separately checked.

NFR-PERF-006.note: The KNO-007 integration test asserts scope and role filters are applied before ranking and that snapshots are repeatable.

NFR-MNT-001.note: Boundaries are workspace packages with declared dependencies checked implicitly by build/typecheck in CI; there is no explicit dependency-rule linter or architecture test.

NFR-MNT-002.note: The domain package declares no dependencies so pnpm strict resolution makes typecheck fail on any SDK/UI/storage import; no explicit architecture test enforces it.

NFR-MNT-003.note: CI applies the versioned, forward-only Drizzle migrations to fresh PostgreSQL 18 and runs the RLS suite on the result; Deploy smoke also runs the migrate service; there is no check that applied migrations are never edited.

NFR-MNT-004.note: Environment config is a Zod schema with tests, the API publishes OpenAPI consumed by the ZAP API scan in CI, and structured-output schemas are tested; there is no machine-readable event schema check.

NFR-MNT-005.note: Coverage is only available as an unenforced test:coverage script and no gate requires 100% of security or state-transition branches, though state-machine tests exist.

NFR-PORT-001.note: Service images are built from one Dockerfile with a frozen lockfile and scanned in CI, but base image tags are not digest-pinned and the document and maintenance workers are not in the image matrix.

NFR-PORT-002.note: Deploy smoke installs the single-server Compose stack on a fresh machine on every PR and checks HTTPS, sign-in, backup and runtime tools; dev Compose is documented and config-checked.

NFR-PORT-003.note: CI runs ingestion and the full app against a generic S3 endpoint (SeaweedFS) and stock PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector; no second S3 vendor is tested.

NFR-PORT-004.note: Production Compose keeps Postgres, object store, Redis, ClamAV, Temporal and Caddy state in named volumes; no automated test proves containers hold no other persistent state.

NFR-PORT-005.note: The backup drill exports the full database and a checksummed object manifest and the runbook describes migration; an automated bundle with secrets references and config does not exist.

NFR-OBS-001.note: API logs are Fastify/pino JSON with a request-id and redaction, but tenant, project, workflow, run and attempt IDs are not emitted per log line and no test asserts the fields.

NFR-OBS-002.note: OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation and a dev-only Tempo/collector profile exist, but no production deployment or test demonstrates a trace from the UI through workflow to a provider call.

NFR-OBS-003.note: Tokens, latency, retries, finish reason and cost are recorded per model invocation and reported (tested), and queue age, export and audit-write metrics have promtool-tested rules; token/latency are DB records rather than Prometheus metrics.

NFR-OBS-004.note: Tests show audit events store redacted titles, provider errors and failure reports scrub keys, and pino redacts auth headers/secret fields; prompt/problem content absence from logs is by design, not asserted.

NFR-UX-001.note: Playwright runs only on Chromium in CI, so the two latest Chrome, Firefox and Safari versions are not verified.

NFR-UX-002.note: axe-core with wcag2a, wcag2aa and wcag22aa tags runs on pages across every e2e spec and fails on serious/critical violations; manual and moderate-impact checks are not covered.

NFR-UX-003.note: E2E tests drive sign-in and reporting by keyboard, check skip-link tab order, focus moves and role=status announcements, plus axe label/contrast rules; no screen-reader run.

NFR-UX-004.note: Tests assert dir=rtl for Persian, locale-aware number/date formatting, and every e2e flow runs in fa; directional icons, table order and chart mirroring are not specifically asserted.

NFR-DATA-001.note: No configurable retention policy exists; active projects are simply never purged (only deleted ones are), which no test asserts.

NFR-DATA-002.note: Tests assert a 30-day purgeAfter window, restore within it, 410 after expiry and purge with audit tombstone; legal hold is not implemented, as the requirement allows.

NFR-DATA-003.note: Purge deletes project rows (with audit tombstone, tested) but does not remove object-store files, caches or confirm embeddings are gone.

NFR-DATA-004.note: Provider retention is mentioned in security docs only; adapters do not document it and the UI shows no retention policy.

NFR-AIQ-001.note: Closed output schemas, invalid_output rejection, and document validation/evaluation gates (length, schema, citations, rubric) are tested; a single universal pre-publish policy gate is not asserted.

NFR-AIQ-002.note: The only fixed corpus (qa/acceptance-corpus) covers OCR and speech ingestion, not a Persian/English evaluation set for AI output quality.

NFR-AIQ-003.note: No workflow or release gate runs regression evals on model or prompt changes; Provider acceptance only checks provider contract and schema compatibility.

NFR-AIQ-004.note: The rubric judge scores requirement coverage, evidence, contradictions and format compliance and research verifies citations against passages (tested with fakes); no fixed benchmark or real-model measurement.

NFR-AIQ-005.note: Tests assert unanswered questions are never turned into facts, unverified findings stay visible as unsupported, and special answer states exist; no confidence score is fabricated, but this is not measured on real models.
